command:
git add src/cli/amend.ts tests/cli-amend-records-race.test.ts docs/cli-reference.md && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
APRV-420: the carriage decision checks that the live records branch carries the attestation

decideLogCarriage dropped the log from the amend commit whenever any
records-log-* branch stood on origin and said "this attestation included".
An advance pushed before the human signed does not carry the record, and
that is the ordinary order. The ceremony now fetches the branch and compares
chains: it says "included" only when the branch's log is equal to or ahead
of the working log, and otherwise says the next advance publishes the record
and the pull request's protected-path guard holds the policy change until a
records branch or main carries it. The commit still never appends to
events.jsonl beside a branch that is appending to it, which is the fix
APRV-420 exists for. Orchestrator review edit; the race test's expected
sentence moves with it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git push -q origin lane-f-540:worktree-agent-a29bee19f50044039 2>&1 | tail -1; gh pr merge 540 --merge 2>&1 | tail -1; gh pr view 540 --json autoMergeRequest,headRefOid --jq '{armed:(.autoMergeRequest!=null), sha:(.headRefOid|.[0:7])}'
